card.name: The word is before contraindicated
card.fires_on: The verb "is" right after a subject about using a drug with an MAOI or similar interacting drug, where the next words state that the combination is contraindicated or not recommended.

modes.label: Is after combined-use subject
modes.description: The word "is" ends a long subject describing use of a drug with an MAOI or within days of stopping it.
